items.title: Nvidia’s $1.1 Billion KYEC Deal Is the Small Number in a $279 Billion Supply Bet
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA:NASDAQ) shares traded about 2% higher on Wednesday, near $220, after the company used its GTC Berlin event on October 21 to put cash behind its supply chain. Nvidia is giving King Yuan Electronics (2449.

items.title: EBay to lay off 9% of workforce in its second round of job cuts this year
items.summary: EBay will lay off 9% of its workforce, or about 1,000 employees, as it works to focus on its "top strategic priorities."

items.title: House prices across capitals post steepest quarterly decline ever: Domain
items.summary: For only the second time ever, house prices have fallen across all Australian capital cities, falling by 4.7 per cent last quarter, the steepest drop on record.

aus.headline: House Prices Post Record Fall
aus.body: Capital city house prices dropped 4.7% last quarter, the biggest fall Domain has recorded.
aus.why: Prices slid in every capital, hitting home values across the country.

us.headline: Nvidia Backs Its Chip Supply Chain
us.body: Nvidia put $1.1b into chip tester KYEC at its Berlin event, and its shares rose about 2%.
us.why: Big AI chip deals can move global tech shares, including ours.

biz.headline: eBay Cuts 9% Of Its Staff
biz.body: eBay is axing about 1,000 jobs, its second round of cuts this year.
biz.why: eBay is a marketplace many Aussie shoppers and sellers use.
